summary: Presidio Production Company entered into purchase and sale agreements to acquire oil and gas properties in Oklahoma from multiple seller parties for $60 million in cash and 2,173,913 shares of common stock, implying a total value of approximately $83 million. The transaction is expected to close early in the third quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. The consideration mix is cash plus stock. Watch for regulatory approvals and satisfaction of closing conditions to assess the risk-arb spread.
